zh: 記者的調查揭露了這則貪污醜聞。

en: Your work performance will determine your end-of-year bonus.
zh: 你的工作表現會決定你的年終獎金。

en: He founded his first company at the age of 27.
zh: 他在 27 歲時創立了第一家公司。

en: The company strictly enforces its dress code policy.
zh: 公司嚴格執行其服裝規定。

en: The company will undertake a new project next month.
zh: 公司下個月將進行一項新專案。

en: Please discard any expired or damaged products.
zh: 請將任何過期或損壞的產品丟棄。

en: They whispered to ensure no one else could hear them.
zh: 他們改用悄悄話，以確保沒有其他人能聽到他們。

en: Sign here to acknowledge receipt of this letter.
zh: 在這裡簽名以確認收到這封信。

en: The management has decided to adopt our suggestions.
zh: 管理層決定採納我們的建議。

en: Let me consult the manager about this matter.
zh: 關於這件事，讓我諮詢一下經理。

en: The money will enable us to upgrade the facilities.
zh: 這筆錢將使我們能夠升級設施。

en: He spoke louder to emphasize his next point in the speech.
zh: 他提高了音量以強調他在演講中的下一個重點。

en: What can we do to enhance the reputation of the company?
zh: 我們可以做些什麼來提高公司的聲譽？

en: He obtained his driver's license after passing the test.
zh: 他通過考試而獲得駕駛執照。

en: I conducted experiments with new teaching methods.
zh: 我用新的教學方法進行了實驗。

en: The venue can accommodate up to 2000 people.
zh: 那個場地可容納多達 2000 人。

en: She dedicated her life to helping others.
zh: 她一生致力於幫助他人。

en: You'll be asked to accompany the manager to client visits.
zh: 你將被要求陪同經理去拜訪客戶。

en: His words imply that he is not satisfied with the situation.
zh: 他的話意味著他對這個狀況感到不滿意。

en: The manager must prioritize tasks for the team.
zh: 經理必須為團隊安排任務的優先順序。

en: Technology continues to evolve at a rapid pace.
zh: 科技不斷迅速進步。

en: The firm was forced to relocate from New York to Boston.
zh: 那家公司被迫從紐約搬遷至波士頓。

en: The police will investigate the crime thoroughly.
zh: 警方將徹底調查此案。

en: He decided to pursue a career in music.
zh: 他決定從事音樂工作。

en: The company plans to distribute the new product globally.
zh: 公司計劃讓新產品全球發售。

en: The students actively engaged in classroom discussions.
zh: 學生們積極參與課堂討論。

en: The drugs can help to relieve the pain.
zh: 這些藥物可以幫助緩解疼痛。

en: The manager will modify the sales strategy tomorrow.
zh: 經理明天會修改銷售策略。

en: They decided to renew their contract for another year.
zh: 他們決定續簽一年的合約。

en: Please notify me if there are any changes to the schedule.
zh: 如果時程表有任何變化，請通知我。

en: She can compose beautiful melodies on the piano.
zh: 她能用鋼琴譜出優美的旋律。

en: The doctor will prescribe medication to treat the infection.
zh: 醫生會開藥治療感染。

en: The meeting was disrupted by the fire drill.
zh: 會議因消防演習而中斷。

en: The manager allocated duties to the assistants.
zh: 經理將職責分配給助理。

en: Despite the challenges, the company continues to thrive.
zh: 儘管遇到挑戰，公司仍然蓬勃發展。

en: Is it reasonable to assume the economy will improve?
zh: 假設經濟會改善是否合理？

en: We need to streamline the process to improve efficiency.
zh: 我們需要簡化流程以提高效率。

en: I'd like to broaden my experience in international affairs.
zh: 我想拓寬我在國際事務方面的經驗。

meaning: 表現不佳；表現差於預期
en: The new product line continues to underperform expectations.
zh: 新產品線的表現持續低於預期。

en: I need to retrieve the file from the computer's backup system.
zh: 我需要從電腦的備份系統將文件復原。

en: Please monitor the temperature in the room.
zh: 請監控房間的溫度。

en: She was granted a scholarship to study abroad.
zh: 她獲得了出國留學的獎學金。

en: I will review the report before submitting it to the manager.
zh: 在提交給經理之前，我會審核這份報告。

en: The company plans to manufacture the product overseas.
zh: 公司計劃在海外製造該產品。

en: They estimate the project will be completed within a month.
zh: 他們估計專案將在一個月內完成。

en: He decided to bid on the antique painting.
zh: 他決定對這幅古董畫出價。

en: He remarked on the excellent presentation.
zh: 他對這場出色的報告做出評述。

en: You can substitute margarine for butter in this recipe.
zh: 這個食譜可以用人造奶油來代替奶油。

en: The government failed to address the problem.
zh: 政府未能處理這個問題。

en: The speaker highlighted the importance of teamwork.
zh: 演講者強調了團隊合作的重要性。

en: Sales declined significantly last quarter.
zh: 上季度的銷售量大幅下降。

en: The company downsized to cut costs and boost profits.
zh: 那家公司為了削減成本和提高利潤而裁員。

en: The mayor released a statement explaining the situation.
zh: 市長發表聲明解釋情況。

en: The manager will delegate the task to his assistant.
zh: 經理將這項任務委託給助理。
